name: Glow words, camera fly-through
what: Four glowing words seen by a flying camera: the first drifts closer, the camera whips round to the second which swings in and settles, then flies through the first as a huge blurred flash, passes the third and lands on the fourth, which tilts upright and pushes in a little to the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f30 word 1 drifts closer (words 2-4 around it); f31-f63 the camera whips round: word 1 shoots off right, word 2 swings in from the left and settles (decelerating); f66-f118 word 2 drifts left growing as word 1 returns from the right growing; f80-f128 the camera flies through word 1 (a huge blurred flash); f123-f198 word 3 appears and drifts down-left, tilting, while word 4 slides in from the upper right and tilts upright; f213-f239 word 4 pushes in; then it holds

tracks.name: drift
tracks.what: word 1 drifts closer, words 3 and 4 slide right with it

tracks.name: whip
tracks.what: the camera whips round: word 1 shoots off right, word 2 swings in from the left

tracks.name: word 2 hold
tracks.what: word 2 sits in the middle, easing back left a little

tracks.name: fly-through
tracks.what: word 2 sweeps off left growing while word 1 returns growing and the camera flies through it

tracks.name: word 3
tracks.what: appears from behind the flash and drifts down-left, tilting, out of the frame

tracks.name: word 4
tracks.what: slides in from the upper right, tilting upright, and settles in the middle
